description: The human_time helper introduced at commit e0f26ed rounded minutes to the nearest hour and then subtracted that rounded hour count, producing negative displayed minutes for half of each hour-scale input cycle until commit 825408b changed both divisions to floor division.
trigger: At affected commit e0f26ed, conversion prints a remaining-time estimate whose rounded minute count modulo 60 is at least 30, beginning around 29 minutes 30 seconds.
expected_behavior: A nonnegative duration representation whose hour and minute components describe the positive estimate.
actual_behavior: At the introduction, the formatter emitted outputs such as '1 hour, -30 minute', '1 hour, -1 minute', and '2 hours, -30 minute'.

introductions.scope: The task diff introduces human_time and its direct remaining-time display call; the parent-tree authoring search found no earlier human_time occurrence.

observations.source: Commit 22 authoring finding and independent Fable mailbox review.
observations.reach: The inspected repository caller prints the estimate after each processed module from absolute index 1 onward. The final-module estimate is zero and prints '< 1 minute' even though later compilation work remains.
observations.limits: Display-only reach was source inspected. Conversion and repository modules were not executed.

fixes.description: Uses floor division for both minutes and hours and omits a zero-minute component for exact hours, removing the negative residual-minute calculation.

limits: Standard-library Python executed transcriptions of the formatter bodies, not repository imports or conversion.
The computation establishes the arithmetic outputs and fix, not performance or model effects.
The final-module estimate scope remains separate from the formatting fix.
